- Provide copies of completed customs entries to clients by email.
- Maintain accurate records within Leda, ensuring commercial paperwork and customs documentation provide a complete audit trail for client record-keeping.

You'll ideally have previous experience in a customs clearance, freight forwarding, logistics or international trade environment, together with a strong understanding of customs procedures and legislation.

This isn't simply an opportunity to join another logistics business.

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen within Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust in the Estate Maintenance Business Administration Team. To work without direct supervision and show extensive use of initiative in prioritising and making decisions in relation to effectively supporting the smooth operation of the service. Raising of purchase orders for the maintenance department using the SBS Oracle system and keeping an accurate record of costs, purchase orders and general queries. To support in the operation of the Estates Helpdesk System, accurately recording routine and emergency service requests, contractor instructions, ensuring records are kept current, notifying clients of action taken and providing progress updates and highlighting any areas of concern as appropriate.
